title: Origin
description: The kind of source a modifier comes from (arcane, divine, alchemy, trained, ...), and how modifiers of one origin stack on one target and op: highest (the strongest bonus and the strongest penalty count) or add (one per source, all add). Referenced as core:origin/<key> from a modifier's or an applied effect's origin. Rules: docs/core/modifier.md#origin.

stack.description: highest: on one target and op, only the strongest bonus and the strongest penalty of this origin count. add: every source of this origin counts, as with no origin. replace: a new source removes every running modifier and tick of this origin first.

defaultFor.description: Emitters whose modifiers carry this origin when the row names none. item_effect is an applied effect on a weapon, armor, accessory, or crafted item; item_stat is the item's own numbers (DR, damage). Each emitter is the default of at most one origin.
